minigame.MG-28.clue.0: Pre-launch checklist: hot-fire test of engine 3 skipped to hold the schedule.
minigame.MG-28.clue.1: Engine 3 turbopump discharge pressure falls to zero within 0.4 s of lift-off.
minigame.MG-28.clue.2: Total thrust drops by one engine's share, vehicle keeps climbing on the rest.
minigame.MG-28.clue.3: Engine controller logs a commanded shutdown of engine 3; guidance re-plans the burn.
minigame.MG-28.clue.4: Engine is a new design; the injector test campaign was cut short.
minigame.MG-28.clue.5: Chamber pressure oscillates at about 1,000 Hz, growing with every cycle.
minigame.MG-28.clue.6: Injector face temperature climbs past its limit in under a second.
minigame.MG-28.clue.7: Thrust collapses and the engine is lost before the vehicle clears the tower.
minigame.MG-28.clue.8: Broadband vibration spike at the engine mount, then silence.
minigame.MG-28.clue.9: Long first stage; the pogo damper test was left out of the build.
minigame.MG-28.clue.10: Longitudinal vibration at about 20 Hz builds up during the first-stage burn.
minigame.MG-28.clue.11: Feed-line pressure swings at the same 20 Hz as the vibration, in step with it.
minigame.MG-28.clue.12: Thrust oscillates by several percent at the same frequency.
minigame.MG-28.clue.13: Axial acceleration peaks climb with each cycle; one engine shuts down on its limit.
minigame.MG-28.clue.14: Throttle-down for maximum dynamic pressure was not flown.
minigame.MG-28.clue.15: Dynamic pressure peaks while thrust is still at 100 %; lateral load passes its limit.
minigame.MG-28.clue.16: Sharp vibration burst from the interstage, then loss of the strain gauge channels.
minigame.MG-28.clue.17: Attitude rates jump beyond control authority and telemetry from the upper stage ends.
minigame.MG-28.clue.18: Weak separation system selected: low push-off force on the stage pair.
minigame.MG-28.clue.19: Separation pulse arrives 80 ms late relative to the main-engine cut-off.
minigame.MG-28.clue.20: Shock sensor on the upper stage reads a second impact after the first separation shock.
minigame.MG-28.clue.21: Upper-stage pitch rate shifts by several degrees per second right after separation.
minigame.MG-28.clue.22: Fairing separation squib armed; one latch circuit shows a marginal reading.
minigame.MG-28.clue.23: Fairing half B separation switch never changes state.
minigame.MG-28.clue.24: Vehicle mass stays 1.2 t above plan; acceleration is lower than predicted.
minigame.MG-28.clue.25: Upper-stage burn ends on propellant depletion with orbital speed still short.
minigame.MG-28.clue.26: Navigation is inertial-only: no star tracker or satellite-navigation update installed.
minigame.MG-28.clue.27: Gyro bias grows slowly; the estimated attitude departs from the true one.
minigame.MG-28.clue.28: Predicted and measured orbit differ by a growing cross-track error.
minigame.MG-28.clue.29: Burn completes normally; the final orbit plane is off by several degrees.
minigame.MG-28.clue.30: Commercial flight computer chosen, with no error-correcting memory.
minigame.MG-28.clue.31: Single-event upset flagged in the guidance memory after crossing the radiation belt.
minigame.MG-28.clue.32: Flight software watchdog trips and the computer reboots into safe mode.
minigame.MG-28.clue.33: Mission clock shows 14 minutes of lost time while the computer restarts.
minigame.MG-28.clue.34: Software-in-the-loop test skipped: the guidance code reused from a slower vehicle.
minigame.MG-28.clue.35: A horizontal-velocity value is converted to a 16-bit integer that is too small.
minigame.MG-28.clue.36: Guidance computer raises an operand-error exception and stops its own processing.
minigame.MG-28.clue.37: Steering commands freeze, then jump to a full-deflection value.
minigame.MG-28.clue.38: Deployable solar arrays chosen; one hinge was not tested cold.
minigame.MG-28.clue.39: Hinge temperature falls well below the cold-soak limit during the eclipse.
minigame.MG-28.clue.40: Array B deployment switch stays open after the command.
minigame.MG-28.clue.41: Bus power runs a deficit; the battery discharges faster than it can recharge.
minigame.MG-28.clue.42: Composite tank with liquid hydrogen: the cryogenic cycling test was not run.
minigame.MG-28.clue.43: Tank ullage pressure sags while the vehicle is on the pad and topping up.
minigame.MG-28.clue.44: A cold spot appears on the tank wall near a weld; the sensor reads colder than the rest.
minigame.MG-28.clue.45: Engine cut-off by propellant depletion arrives early; propellant mass is below plan.
minigame.MG-28.clue.46: Heat shield rated for a shallower entry than the one flown.
minigame.MG-28.clue.47: Entry path angle steeper than planned; peak heating rate is higher than predicted.
minigame.MG-28.clue.48: Backshell thermocouples read an abrupt rise as the shield thins out.
minigame.MG-28.clue.49: Telemetry channels from the heat shield drop out one by one.
minigame.MG-28.clue.50: No full-scale drop test of the parachute sequence was flown.
minigame.MG-28.clue.51: Parachute deploy command sent; the cutter sensor was wired with reversed polarity.
minigame.MG-28.clue.52: Mortar fires on time but the canopies are never released.
minigame.MG-28.clue.53: Descent speed stays high; impact acceleration is far above the design limit.
minigame.MG-28.clue.54: Pad range safety rules: the vehicle must stay inside its planned corridor.
minigame.MG-28.clue.55: Pitch programme error grows; the track moves away from the planned ground path.
minigame.MG-28.clue.56: The tracking radar reports the vehicle outside the corridor limit.
minigame.MG-28.clue.57: Flight-termination command is received and acted upon over open ocean.
minigame.MG-28.clue.58: Pad weather: the outside air temperature is a few degrees below the forecast.
minigame.MG-28.clue.59: A brief dropout in the S-band link while the antenna switches over.
minigame.MG-28.clue.60: Normal engine start-up vibration, inside the expected band.
minigame.MG-28.clue.61: A short, normal inrush current when a heater switches on.
minigame.MG-28.clue.62: Countdown held for one minute for a boat on the range; resumed on time.
minigame.MG-28.clue.63: Helium bottle pressure follows its normal slow decay during the countdown.
minigame.MG-28.clue.64: Stage-separation timing is within a millisecond of the plan.
minigame.MG-28.clue.65: One redundant sensor reads a single spurious value; its twin does not.
